99 PRs merged this week. The garden acquired a hosted MCP tool shelf, a model catalog that behaves more like a map, more video and reference inputs, and better ways for community model owners to see what their plants are doing. Also: lots of accounting, retries, limits, and pricing fixes—the irrigation system of software. 🌱🐝

Everything is in the open: github.com/pollinations
